main_text.head: II. Libri pars: QUOS EX SANCTIS, QUIBUS, PONTIFICII PATRONOS AC DEOS TUTELARES assignarint.
main_text.p: HActenus, Lector Christiane, de horrenda Idololatria Pontificia, quæ in sanctorum Invocatione committitur, etiam de salutatione Angelica, quam Monachi imprudentes in formam precum commutare non dubitarunt, egimus plus satis. Eaque refutatio ut evidentior tibi redderetur, placuit exempla nō pauca, & illa quidem maximè perspicua subjicere, ad quorum commemorationem vel cordatus pectore toto cohorrescat. Denique formulas nonnullas magicæ & in Deum blasphemæ consecrationis addere libuit.

Reliquum est, ut, cùm opusculum hoc, præter opinionem, longiùs excrescat, breviter de secunda & tertia libelli parte, & earum quidem illa de Sanctorum patrocinio, de eorundem Reliquiis hac postrema deinceps agatur.

page.notes: Printed text is set in roman with some italic passages; the heading lines are in spaced capitals. The word "Heading" "II. Libri pars:" is a part label. Some words in the body are doubtful due to ink show-through from the reverse side (ignored). Top-right faint mirrored text is show-through and omitted. The phrase "deinceps" in the last line appears partly obscured by the printed mark over "deinceps"; reading uncertain.
